question: An angle greater than 180 degrees is referred to as ________________.
solution:
The correct answer is __a reflex angle**(Option 3)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• A reflex angle__ is an angle that measures greater than 180 degrees but less than 360 degrees.
 
• It is larger than a straight angle (180 degrees).
 
• For example, an angle measuring 270 degrees is a reflex angle.
 
• Reflex angles are used in geometry, engineering, and various scientific applications.
 
• They are typically represented in diagrams with arcs that extend beyond the straight line.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Right Angle:**
 
 
• A right angle measures exactly 90 degrees.
 
• It is formed when two lines intersect perpendicularly.
 
 
 
• **Acute Angle:**
 
 
• An acute angle is any angle that measures less than 90 degrees.
 
 
 
• **Obtuse Angle:**
 
 
• An obtuse angle is any angle that measures more than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.
